verdicts.reason: A shrinks the headline to almost the size of the cyan attribution, which wrecks the hierarchy. Its quote mark is reduced to a speck, the logo floats above the text column without sharing its left edge, and the right third of the canvas is dead space. B keeps a dominant two-line headline with a hanging quote mark that fits the banner well, but 'Rated 5 out of 5' is squeezed into a cramped three-line orphan jammed against the logo, and the bottom row and the headline both crowd the canvas edges.
